title_zh: 钱进来以后，什么不能跟着卖
title_en: What Money Cannot Buy at a University
deck_zh: 学费、捐款、科研经费，都可以有自己的账。人的去路，却不能在账目结清以前被一并扣下。
deck_en: Tuition, donations, and research contracts need accounts. They do not put a price on people, buy a favorable conclusion, or settle what happens when an institution can no longer continue.
body_zh: 学生要转学，对方要看成绩单。课已经上过，考试已经考过，记录也在学校手里，只是学生还欠着一笔钱。现在，先付钱，才给记录。校方收的究竟是债，还是学生继续往前走的资格？
这不是只在设想里才会发生的问题。加州2019年通过的AB1313，禁止学校因学生欠款扣住成绩单，也禁止把出具成绩单当作收债工具。这部法律没有解决所有收费与服务的争议，却把一条可以写进规则的界线摆了出来。
记录为什么能用来催债？恰恰因为它重要。转学、求职、继续深造，都可能需要它。扣住的不是一张纸的工本费，而是一个人已经做过的事通往下一处的证明。收债有效，不足以独自说明这种手段正当。
不过，一谈钱就先皱眉，也谈不下去。教书的人要领工资，实验室要买仪器，图书馆要续订资料。学费、捐款、委托研究、场地服务，都会进入账本。大学需要收入，不是它的污点；撑不下去，在读的人往往先遇到困难。
公共资金也不是一句免问的好话。为什么保障这一项教育供给，为什么支持这个研究方向，为什么要维持这一所学校，是不同的问题。获得支持，不能替学校做过的每件事背书，也不证明这个组织必须永远存续。
分经费、名额与研究假，会改变别人可走的路，因而也是一种权力。它不必先被改名为学术评价，才需要说明与制衡。钱当然要分；分给谁、依什么、谁能对分配提出异议，不能在“资源有限”四个字里一起结束。
钱可以买什么，可以从最普通的交换说起。学校付工资，买的是教师、职员和助教承担的工作，不是这些人本身。学生交学费，获得课程、服务、使用图书馆与实验室的条件，不是买下另一个人的全部时间与意志。
同样，学费买不到一个“已经合格”。学生有权要求学校认真教学、认真评定，不能因已经付款就要求合格；学校收了钱，也不能拿一次空泛的盖章，替代应当提供的条件与应当进行的核实。双方承担的事都要算数。
学位与成绩单记录的是实际做过并经过评定的工作。欠款可以依它自己的根据与程序处理，把已有记录扣成收债的筹码，是另外一个动作，需要另外说明。这里守的是人的工作不被任意拿走这一条，不是从一部法律推出所有教育都必须免费。
研究合同还有另一条界线。一家公司请实验室测一种材料，可以购买测量、报告和约定的交付期限，却买不到预先选好的结果。证据测出来是什么，就得说明什么；否则交付的已经不是那项研究，而是花钱安排的一句答案。
费用本身并不都在堵路。可当它成了某些人继续学习或取得学位绕不过去的条件，就要问得更具体：有没有可用的奖助，费用怎样形成，哪一项条件不能承受，异议由谁处理。不能只说“有价格”，也不能只说“他可以选择不读”。
捐赠也常带条件。出钱支持某个领域，和要求某个人必须受聘，是两回事；约定设一个讲席，和捐赠人保留否决讲授内容的权力，也不是同一件事。不能把这一切，都塞进“支持学术”一个好听的说法里。
至少有三样需要拆开看：钱约定用在什么地方，学术决定由谁作，受资助的人自己认同什么。用途可以约定，聘任与研究要由相应职责的位置判断，一个人内心的认领更不随资助一并转让。笼统一句“不干预”，不能替这三项分别作答。
耶鲁的受赠审查政策，明确拒绝干预录取、聘任、研究和课程等自主决定、侵犯学术自由的赠与条件。这不是禁止一切用途限定。它提示的是另一种实在的工作：看协议写了什么，谁审条件，出资方有没有席位或否决权。
球场上也能看见两种位置挤在一起。运动员在比赛，也在读书。门票、转播和赞助可以有价格，却不能因为比赛有收入，就取消运动员完成学业的实际条件。训练与课程撞上了，不能只让那个夹在中间的人自己想办法。
NCAA第一级别的核心保障，在特定资格与资助条件下，限制因伤病、竞技表现等体育理由削减或不续奖学金，并要求相关通知与申诉机会。适用条件不能省略；它至少示范了怎样把一时的竞技贡献，与继续学习所需的条件拉开距离。
还有一种钱更难安排：一个研究者说，我想做这件事，但现在不能许诺它会换成什么已知回报。大多数经费申请当然可以问值不值得，要求说明用途与交付。诚实回答这些问题，不等于已经出卖了自己。
可若所有入口，都先要求证明已知产出，探索便只能在已经承认的结果里找路。大学既然要给判断与探索提供条件，就应当至少留一处，让说得出、暂时量不出的理由也有资格被考虑。这是这一系列承担的规范选择，不是现行资助制度的事实描述。
至少一处，不是处处；被考虑，也不是必获资助。理由仍可追问，资源仍须取舍，承诺的工作仍要承担。这里不另设一场“你是不是真正热爱”的考试，也不让“这是我的兴趣”变成别人不能再问的通行证。
更不能表面允许申请，随后仍只因没有同一项预定回报将它排除。那只把门往里挪了一步。留出的入口究竟有多大、怎样选择、谁说明拒绝的理由，应当能看得见，而不只是申请须知里一句宽容的口号。
大众汽车基金会已经结束的Experiment!计划，提供过一种可参考的形态：短稿可以申请，想法失败与意外结果可以接受；经过预选与匿名评审，一部分合格申请再用抽签分配。它不是所有资助都抽签，更不是一家大学已经兑现全部承诺的证明。
它的意义有限，却很具体：不是只有预先排出最可能成功的顺序，钱才分得下去。另一种安排做得出来，至于效果如何、大学怎样采用，还需要各自核实。钱少，不自动免掉想办法的责任；想办法，也不免掉把限度讲清的责任。
导师制度也有自己的账。假设一位教授名下挂了三十个学生，却拿不出可用的指导时间，再多一份配对名单也补不上缺口。学校要安排指导，就该把时间、人手与负担算进去，不能把没有安排的条件改称老师应有的奉献。
换导师所需的过渡支持，同样要有承担者、期限与限度，不能仍由原导师一个人捏住。不说任何资源都是无限的；恰恰因为有限，哪里提供、哪里接不上、谁负责接续，才更不能让学生到断掉的那一天才发现。
大学真有维持不下去的时候。汉普郡学院在2026年5月的公告中宣布，董事会决定在当年秋季学期后关闭学院，并提出让学生在本校或合作院校完成学业的安排。这是学校公布的决定与计划，不是每个人已经顺利转走的证明。
这时首先要接续的，是在读者的学习，不是原来那个组织的永久存在。能在本校完成，就认真保住条件；做不到，就为到别处继续提供实际可用的条件。尚未完成的学术要求仍要完成，接续不是一张保证人人毕业的支票。
一张合作院校名单还不够。学分接不接受，课程接不接得上，资料拿不拿得到，费用会怎样变，对方有没有真实容量，学生能否选择，都得逐项走到能用。谁判断本校已无法继续，也要把根据、涉及的人与代价说清，接受独立的追问。
HLC的接续政策把一些具体条件写进了认证安排，包括合理的完成机会、协议中的费用说明；在没有获批计划就关闭的情形，又限定在可行范围内协助学生不增加费用地完成学业。这些是不同条款，不能拼成普遍的免费毕业保证。
成绩与学位记录的保存，教师和职员的后续安排，也不能留作一笔结余处理。组织结束了，已经发生的工作与尚待承接的责任不会因此一起消失。提前准备，比等人站在关掉的门外再解释“没钱了”，更接近大学应有的负责。
钱不是教育的反面。把它讲清，反而能让许多不该靠好心硬撑的事，得到真正的条件。该支付的工作认真支付，该履行的承诺认真履行；但不因为钱进来了，就连人的方向、研究的结论和继续往前的路，也顺手算进可以买走的东西。
body_en: Imagine a student preparing to transfer. The new institution needs a transcript. The classes were taken, the examinations completed, and the record exists. But an unpaid balance remains, so the record stays where it is. The bill has acquired leverage over something larger than payment: the student's next step.

California addressed this particular leverage through AB1313, signed in 2019. It prohibited withholding transcripts because of student debt and using their issuance for debt collection. That historical boundary is narrower than a rule covering every service or charge. It nevertheless shows that an institution's collection methods can be limited in writing.

A transcript can be useful leverage precisely because it matters. Another college, an employer, or a graduate program may need it. Withholding the document blocks the passage of work already performed into another setting. Even if that tactic collects debts effectively, effectiveness alone does not justify the power being exercised.

None of this makes income a stain on education. Faculty and staff need salaries; laboratories need equipment; libraries need resources. Tuition, gifts, commissioned research, and services all enter university accounts. Financial failure can hurt current students first. Pretending that a university ought to float above money would leave its obligations without conditions for their performance.

Public money requires explanations too. Protecting educational provision, supporting a research activity, and preserving this particular organization are different decisions. A grant does not endorse every institutional act or establish a right to indefinite institutional survival. Whoever allocates public support should explain what it is intended to secure.

Allocating funds, places, and leave also exercises power: it changes other people's available routes. That power needs reasons and checks without first being renamed academic assessment. Scarcity makes choices necessary; it does not complete the explanation of who chooses, on what grounds, or how an objection can reach them.

Begin with ordinary purchases. Salaries pay for teaching, administration, and assistance, not ownership of the people performing them. Tuition buys courses, services, and conditions for using facilities. It does not buy another person's unlimited availability or their will. Payment specifies work; it should not absorb a life.

Nor can tuition purchase the verdict that a student has qualified. Students can demand serious teaching and assessment, not a favorable result because a bill was paid. The institution, for its part, cannot replace the conditions and verification it owes with an empty stamp. The obligations on both sides must remain real.

Degrees and transcripts concern actual work and its assessment. A debt can be addressed through its own grounds and procedures. Turning access to an existing academic record into collection leverage is an additional act requiring justification. This argument does not derive universal tuition-free education from one state's legislation.

A research contract draws another boundary. A company can purchase material testing, a report, and an agreed delivery date. It cannot thereby purchase the finding it wanted before the measurements began. A conclusion must follow the evidence. Otherwise what has been delivered is a purchased answer, not the contracted inquiry.

A fee does not invariably block a route. But when an unaffordable payment becomes unavoidable for continuing study or obtaining a qualification, its operation needs examination. Are assistance arrangements usable? Who explains the charge and receives objections? Merely saying that a price exists, or that someone may choose not to study, does not answer those questions.

Donations can also carry different kinds of conditions. Funding a field differs from reserving a veto over its appointments. Endowing a chair differs from controlling what its holder may teach. Calling all these arrangements support for scholarship conceals distinctions that matter to the people expected to work under them.

Three questions should remain separate: the agreed use of money, authority over academic decisions, and the recipient's personal endorsement. A use can be specified; appointments and research require the appropriate academic responsibility; personal conviction is not transferred with a grant. A general assurance of noninterference cannot settle all three.

Yale's gift policy explicitly rejects conditions interfering with institutional academic autonomy or faculty academic freedom, including matters such as appointments, research, and curriculum. It does not prohibit every restriction on use. The practical work is to examine the agreement, its reviewer, and any donor participation or veto, rather than rely on a reassuring label.

On the playing field, two roles can become crowded together. An athlete competes and studies. Tickets, broadcasting, and sponsorship may have prices; sporting income does not cancel the actual conditions needed to complete an education. When training and classes conflict, the person between them should not be left alone to absorb the contradiction.

The NCAA's Division I core guarantees offer a bounded example. Under specified aid and eligibility conditions, they protect scholarships against reductions or nonrenewal for athletics-related reasons, including injury or performance, and provide notice and appeal opportunities. Those conditions matter. This is not a guarantee covering every form of student support.

Some requests for money are harder to express. A researcher wants to investigate something but cannot promise a familiar return. Most applications can legitimately ask whether work is worth supporting and require uses, deliverables, and deadlines. Answering such questions honestly is not inherently a surrender of one's direction.

Yet if every entrance requires proof of a predetermined output, exploration can proceed only toward results already recognized. A university committed to conditions for judgment should leave at least one entrance where intelligible but unquantified reasons can receive consideration. This is the normative commitment made here, not a description of existing funding systems.

At least one does not mean every entrance. Consideration does not mean an award. Reasons remain open to questions, allocations require choices, and actual commitments remain binding. Nor should this become an examination of authentic passion or purity of motive. Personal interest cannot turn into a new immunity from being questioned.

It would also be dishonest to accept such an application formally, then reject it solely for lacking the very predetermined return supposedly waived. That moves the barrier inside. The entrance needs visible arrangements: its size, its selection process, and an answerable explanation of rejection, not merely welcoming language in the guidelines.

The Volkswagen Foundation's completed Experiment! program illustrates one possible form. It accepted short proposals and allowed conceptual failure and unexpected findings. Following preliminary selection and anonymous assessment, some eligible applications received funding by lottery. Not all funding was randomized, and a foundation's program does not demonstrate fulfillment of every obligation proposed for universities.

The limited lesson is useful: money can be allocated without ranking every recipient solely by a forecast of success. Effects and institutional adaptations need separate investigation. Scarcity does not erase responsibility to consider alternatives; trying alternatives does not erase responsibility to explain their limits. Neither requires a promise that resources become unlimited.

Advising has an account as well. Imagine a professor assigned thirty students without usable time to meet them. A list of matches cannot supply the missing guidance. An institution arranging advisers should account for time, staffing, and workload, rather than rename unprovided conditions as a teacher's duty of selfless devotion.

Transition support for changing advisers likewise needs a responsible source, duration, and limits. It should not remain under the original adviser's sole control. Limited resources make it more important to state what is available, where gaps remain, and who arranges continuity before a student reaches the point of interruption.

Sometimes an institution cannot continue. In a May 2026 announcement, Hampshire College reported its board's decision to close after the fall semester and described arrangements for students to complete at Hampshire or a partner institution. That is an announced decision and plan, not proof that every student's continuation has already succeeded.

The priority should be continuity of current students' education, not perpetual survival of the original organization. Preserve actual conditions for completion there if possible; otherwise provide usable conditions for continuing elsewhere. Academic requirements still have to be met. Continuity is not a promise to award every unfinished degree.

A partner list alone will not do. Credits, courses, access to records, changed costs, receiving capacity, and student choice all need practical answers. Whoever concludes that the institution can no longer sustain study should explain the grounds, people affected, and costs, with a route for independent questioning of that judgment.

HLC's teach-out policy includes reasonable opportunities for completion and fee disclosures in agreements. A separate provision, for closure without approved arrangements, limits assistance toward completion without additional charges to what is feasible. These provisions cannot be combined into a universal guarantee of cost-free graduation. Implementation requires its own examination.

Preservation of academic records and arrangements for faculty and staff also need explanations. Closing an organization does not erase work already performed or obligations still awaiting continuity. Preparing before a crisis is more responsible than telling people outside a shut door that the money has run out.

Money is not education's opposite. Clear accounts can give real conditions to work otherwise sustained by goodwill alone. Pay for work properly; honor commitments seriously. But do not quietly add personal direction, research conclusions, and another person's passage forward to the list of things that money has purchased.

source_points: 钱非污点，公共供给保障与某组织存续分开，支持不背书；资源分配为独立权力非改名评价
价格落事非人；付钱不买学位记录或合格判定；委托不买预定结论；收费成不可绕门时另受问不推出免费教育
用途约定、学术决策权、个人认领三项分，不用不干预总包；捐款可带可说明用途交付治理约定但不替人定向
运动员比赛与学生角色分，利益不撤学业条件，学习训练比赛受雇冲突需路不判雇员法律身份
分资源至少一处允许不先换算已知回报的理由，只至少一处非处处；考虑非必得，理由可问，承诺照担
不设真热爱无功利心认证、不以内心回看作放行测试、不形式收件仍以缺同一指标拒绝
Experiment完成计划，基金会非大学，预选匿名评审合格后部分抽签，形态非实效认证
导师时间人手负担与换导师过渡款的来源期限限度均需安排，不耗尽给予者
关闭先续在读学业非组织永续，不能继续判断受问，学分课程材料费用真实接收选择可用，记录教师职员另安排
HLC费用披露与无计划关闭可行范围协助分读，不包免费毕业，接续不包通过未完学业
limits: 不裁定学费合理数额、税务、政府科研拨款、体育联盟整体规则、运动员雇员身份
收入分成合约源文未取得具体条款，未因形式断言封路，正文不增断语

facts.claim: California AB1313 was signed in 2019 and prohibited transcript withholding for debt and collection leverage
facts.verification: 2026-11-16 official California Attorney General announcement dated 2019-10-04 read in indexed primary full text; official legislative analysis also checked. Exact present Education Code66022 exceptions not asserted; legislation portal inaccessible.

facts.claim: Yale policy rejects gifts interfering with academic autonomy and freedom without forbidding all use restrictions
facts.verification: 2026-11-16 canonical official page and indexed primary policy clauses read; no monetary approval threshold claim and no implementation finding.

facts.claim: NCAA Division I guarantees restrict athletics-related scholarship reduction under specified first-year aid and remaining-eligibility conditions with notice and appeal
facts.verification: 2026-11-16 official page258–270 read; not extended to all aid, all divisions, or employee legal status.

facts.claim: Completed Experiment! program accepted conceptual failure and used partial lottery after selection
facts.verification: 2026-11-16 official program54–65 read; preliminary selection and anonymous assessment retained, only some eligible funding randomized; no causal effectiveness claim.

facts.claim: Hampshire announced closure after fall2026 with proposed completion at Hampshire or partner
facts.verification: 2026-11-16 official closure page with November4 update and May12 announcement read; distinguished future announced closure from already closed, institutional stated reasons from independent findings, and plan from achieved continuity. Unverified June loan omitted.

facts.claim: HLC policy separates teach-out fee disclosure from no-plan closure assistance to extent feasible
facts.verification: 2026-11-16 full indexed official primary policy read despite direct403, and primary February2025 adopted-policy PDF checked. Current policy INST.G.30.010 after September2026 renumbering; body uses no policy number. Not universal no-extra-cost graduation guarantee.

scope_notes: 开头为设想学生场景，随后明确历史CA规则；公司材料测量、三十学生指导为原文设例非新增报道

body_hant: 學生要轉學，對方要看成績單。課已經上過，考試已經考過，記錄也在學校手裡，只是學生還欠著一筆錢。現在，先付錢，才給記錄。校方收的究竟是債，還是學生繼續往前走的資格？
這不是只在設想裡才會發生的問題。加州2019年通過的AB1313，禁止學校因學生欠款扣住成績單，也禁止把出具成績單當作收債工具。這部法律沒有解決所有收費與服務的爭議，卻把一條可以寫進規則的界線擺了出來。
記錄為什麼能用來催債？恰恰因為它重要。轉學、求職、繼續深造，都可能需要它。扣住的不是一張紙的工本費，而是一個人已經做過的事通往下一處的證明。收債有效，不足以獨自說明這種手段正當。
不過，一談錢就先皺眉，也談不下去。教書的人要領工資，實驗室要買儀器，圖書館要續訂資料。學費、捐款、委託研究、場地服務，都會進入帳本。大學需要收入，不是它的污點；撐不下去，在讀的人往往先遇到困難。
公共資金也不是一句免問的好話。為什麼保障這一項教育供給，為什麼支持這個研究方向，為什麼要維持這一所學校，是不同的問題。獲得支持，不能替學校做過的每件事背書，也不證明這個組織必須永遠存續。
分經費、名額與研究假，會改變別人可走的路，因而也是一種權力。它不必先被改名為學術評價，才需要說明與制衡。錢當然要分；分給誰、依什麼、誰能對分配提出異議，不能在「資源有限」四個字裡一起結束。
錢可以買什麼，可以從最普通的交換說起。學校付工資，買的是教師、職員和助教承擔的工作，不是這些人本身。學生交學費，獲得課程、服務、使用圖書館與實驗室的條件，不是買下另一個人的全部時間與意志。
同樣，學費買不到一個「已經合格」。學生有權要求學校認真教學、認真評定，不能因已經付款就要求合格；學校收了錢，也不能拿一次空泛的蓋章，替代應當提供的條件與應當進行的核實。雙方承擔的事都要算數。
學位與成績單記錄的是實際做過並經過評定的工作。欠款可以依它自己的根據與程序處理，把已有記錄扣成收債的籌碼，是另外一個動作，需要另外說明。這裡守的是人的工作不被任意拿走這一條，不是從一部法律推出所有教育都必須免費。
研究合同還有另一條界線。一家公司請實驗室測一種材料，可以購買測量、報告和約定的交付期限，卻買不到預先選好的結果。證據測出來是什麼，就得說明什麼；否則交付的已經不是那項研究，而是花錢安排的一句答案。
費用本身並不都在堵路。可當它成了某些人繼續學習或取得學位繞不過去的條件，就要問得更具體：有沒有可用的獎助，費用怎樣形成，哪一項條件不能承受，異議由誰處理。不能只說「有價格」，也不能只說「他可以選擇不讀」。
捐贈也常帶條件。出錢支持某個領域，和要求某個人必須受聘，是兩回事；約定設一個講席，和捐贈人保留否決講授內容的權力，也不是同一件事。不能把這一切，都塞進「支持學術」一個好聽的說法裡。
至少有三樣需要拆開看：錢約定用在什麼地方，學術決定由誰作，受資助的人自己認同什麼。用途可以約定，聘任與研究要由相應職責的位置判斷，一個人內心的認領更不隨資助一並轉讓。籠統一句「不干預」，不能替這三項分別作答。
耶魯的受贈審查政策，明確拒絕干預錄取、聘任、研究和課程等自主決定、侵犯學術自由的贈與條件。這不是禁止一切用途限定。它提示的是另一種實在的工作：看協議寫了什麼，誰審條件，出資方有沒有席位或否決權。
球場上也能看見兩種位置擠在一起。運動員在比賽，也在讀書。門票、轉播和贊助可以有價格，卻不能因為比賽有收入，就取消運動員完成學業的實際條件。訓練與課程撞上了，不能只讓那個夾在中間的人自己想辦法。
NCAA第一級別的核心保障，在特定資格與資助條件下，限制因傷病、競技表現等體育理由削減或不續獎學金，並要求相關通知與申訴機會。適用條件不能省略；它至少示範了怎樣把一時的競技貢獻，與繼續學習所需的條件拉開距離。
還有一種錢更難安排：一個研究者說，我想做這件事，但現在不能許諾它會換成什麼已知回報。大多數經費申請當然可以問值不值得，要求說明用途與交付。誠實回答這些問題，不等於已經出賣了自己。
可若所有入口，都先要求證明已知產出，探索便只能在已經承認的結果裡找路。大學既然要給判斷與探索提供條件，就應當至少留一處，讓說得出、暫時量不出的理由也有資格被考慮。這是這一系列承擔的規範選擇，不是現行資助制度的事實描述。
至少一處，不是處處；被考慮，也不是必獲資助。理由仍可追問，資源仍須取捨，承諾的工作仍要承擔。這裡不另設一場「你是不是真正熱愛」的考試，也不讓「這是我的興趣」變成別人不能再問的通行證。
更不能表面允許申請，隨後仍只因沒有同一項預定回報將它排除。那只把門往裡挪了一步。留出的入口究竟有多大、怎樣選擇、誰說明拒絕的理由，應當能看得見，而不只是申請須知裡一句寬容的口號。
大眾汽車基金會已經結束的Experiment!計劃，提供過一種可參考的形態：短稿可以申請，想法失敗與意外結果可以接受；經過預選與匿名評審，一部分合格申請再用抽籤分配。它不是所有資助都抽籤，更不是一家大學已經兌現全部承諾的證明。
它的意義有限，卻很具體：不是只有預先排出最可能成功的順序，錢才分得下去。另一種安排做得出來，至於效果如何、大學怎樣採用，還需要各自核實。錢少，不自動免掉想辦法的責任；想辦法，也不免掉把限度講清的責任。
導師制度也有自己的帳。假設一位教授名下掛了三十個學生，卻拿不出可用的指導時間，再多一份配對名單也補不上缺口。學校要安排指導，就該把時間、人手與負擔算進去，不能把沒有安排的條件改稱老師應有的奉獻。
換導師所需的過渡支持，同樣要有承擔者、期限與限度，不能仍由原導師一個人捏住。不說任何資源都是無限的；恰恰因為有限，哪裡提供、哪裡接不上、誰負責接續，才更不能讓學生到斷掉的那一天才發現。
大學真有維持不下去的時候。漢普郡學院在2026年5月的公告中宣佈，董事會決定在當年秋季學期後關閉學院，並提出讓學生在本校或合作院校完成學業的安排。這是學校公佈的決定與計劃，不是每個人已經順利轉走的證明。
這時首先要接續的，是在讀者的學習，不是原來那個組織的永久存在。能在本校完成，就認真保住條件；做不到，就為到別處繼續提供實際可用的條件。尚未完成的學術要求仍要完成，接續不是一張保證人人畢業的支票。
一張合作院校名單還不夠。學分接不接受，課程接不接得上，資料拿不拿得到，費用會怎樣變，對方有沒有真實容量，學生能否選擇，都得逐項走到能用。誰判斷本校已無法繼續，也要把根據、涉及的人與代價說清，接受獨立的追問。
HLC的接續政策把一些具體條件寫進了認證安排，包括合理的完成機會、協議中的費用說明；在沒有獲批計劃就關閉的情形，又限定在可行範圍內協助學生不增加費用地完成學業。這些是不同條款，不能拼成普遍的免費畢業保證。
成績與學位記錄的保存，教師和職員的後續安排，也不能留作一筆結餘處理。組織結束了，已經發生的工作與尚待承接的責任不會因此一起消失。提前準備，比等人站在關掉的門外再解釋「沒錢了」，更接近大學應有的負責。
錢不是教育的反面。把它講清，反而能讓許多不該靠好心硬撐的事，得到真正的條件。該支付的工作認真支付，該履行的承諾認真履行；但不因為錢進來了，就連人的方向、研究的結論和繼續往前的路，也順手算進可以買走的東西。
